claim.point: Three clients still call the v1 API, so deleting it in this release would break live integrations.
claim.detail: Northwind Freight sends about 40% of v1 traffic and says its migration is planned for Q1; Pellucid Health and Orchard & Vale send the rest.

ask.point: Decide whether to delete the v1 endpoints in this release as planned, or keep them longer while the clients migrate.
ask.detail: The next release is about six weeks later, in early January.

stakes.point: Deleting now breaks those clients' integrations; keeping v1 leaves the static-token security finding open past its 30 November remediation date.
stakes.detail: Keeping it needs a documented risk acceptance from the API owner with a new date; Northwind's shipment sync is the largest integration at risk.
